prompt: How many active players have won one or more ATP Finals singles titles? Please note that Andy Murray is no longer active.
answer: 6 active players have won one or more ATP Finals singles titles: **Novak Djokovic, Alexander Zverev, Jannik Sinner, Grigor Dimitrov, Stefanos Tsitsipas, and Daniil Medvedev**. Andy Murray is excluded because he is no longer active.
